note: Subretinal AAV-RPGR: cotoretigene (XIRIUS 2021) and botaretigene (LUMEOS 2025) missed their primary endpoints; laru-zova's pivotal VISTA met its LLVA primary in 2026 after XLPRA2 dog studies set its doses.
label: XLRP (RPGR gene therapy)

engagement.confidence_note: Abstract-level (Europe PMC, PMID 28549772). Year is publication; XIRIUS phase 1/2 started 2017-03-08.
engagement.judgement: Transgene RPGR expression (the model's PD readout) has no human counterpart: no retinal biopsy in trials, so not_measured.
engagement.note: Codon-optimised RPGR expressed full-length, correctly glutamylated protein at the connecting cilium and rescued degeneration in two mouse lines.
engagement.quote: Significantly, when delivered by AAV8 vector and driven by the rhodopsin kinase promoter, the codon-optimized RPGR rescues the disease phenotype in two relevant animal models (Rpgr-/y and C57BL/6JRd9/Boc) and shows good safety in C57BL6/J wild-type mice.
engagement.reason: RPGR protein cannot be sampled in patients

engagement.confidence_note: Abstract-level (PMID 32414297). Year is a proxy (HORIZON start 2018-04-16).
engagement.judgement: Microperimetry gains are efficacy, not engagement; no proximal transgene readout exists in treated eyes.
engagement.note: AGTC-501 expressed RPGR and corrected rod and cone opsin mislocalisation in XLPRA2 dogs; neither readout is measurable in patients.
engagement.quote: Subretinal administration of rAAV2tYF-GRK1-hRPGRco and rAAV2tYF-GRK1-hRPGRstb both corrected rod and cone opsin mislocalization, two early markers of disease in the XLPRA2 canine model of RPGR-XLRP.
engagement.reason: Opsin localisation not measurable in patients

engagement.model: Isogenic RPGR-knockout human iPSC retinal organoids, AAV-RPGR clinical construct (bota-vec)
engagement.note: AAV-RPGR restored RPGR protein, glutamylation and connecting-cilium localisation and corrected rhodopsin mislocalisation in KO organoids; none is measured in patients.
engagement.short: Organoid RPGR and opsin readouts restored
engagement.quote: The transduction of RPGR-KO ROs using AAV-RPGR successfully restored RPGR mRNA and protein expression and localisation to the photoreceptor connecting cilium in rod and cone photoreceptors.
engagement.confidence_note: Full text (PMC10855600). Organoids carried the bota-vec hRKp.RPGR cassette in an AAV7m8 capsid, not the clinical AAV5, so product_in_model is false.
engagement.judgement: RPGR localisation and opsin trafficking cannot be sampled in dosed patients' retinas, so engagement stays untested.

dose.confidence_note: Abstract-level (Europe PMC, PMID 28549772). Year is publication; XIRIUS phase 1/2 started 2017-03-08.
dose.judgement: XIRIUS doses were escalated clinically; no mouse-derived target was stated in the abstract.
dose.note: Mouse doses were per-eye vector genomes with no stated human dose, exposure or tolerability margin.
dose.quote: Significantly, when delivered by AAV8 vector and driven by the rhodopsin kinase promoter, the codon-optimized RPGR rescues the disease phenotype in two relevant animal models (Rpgr-/y and C57BL/6JRd9/Boc) and shows good safety in C57BL6/J wild-type mice.
dose.reason: Mouse work stated no human dose

dose.confidence_note: Abstract-level (PMID 32414297). Year is a proxy (HORIZON start 2018-04-16).
dose.note: Dog dose-ranging and GLP toxicity set a NOAEL of 6 x 10^11 vg/mL and guided the first human doses.
dose.short: Dogs set NOAEL and starting dose
dose.quote: These results support the selection and use of rAAV2tYF-GRK1-hRPGRco (AGTC-501) and guided the initial doses in clinical studies in patients with XLRP caused by RPGR mutations.

dose.magnitude_basis: dog NOAEL 6 x 10^11 vg/mL (toxic at 3 x 10^12 vg/mL) vs human toxic top dose 1.99 x 10^12 vg/eye; human injection concentrations not found
dose.confidence_note: Abstract-level (PMID 39643074). HORIZON (NCT03316560) has no posted results. Human vg/mL not in the abstract, so the margin is compared only in shape (tolerated mid range, toxic top).
dose.judgement: Judgement call: scored same with margin_stated because the dog stated a tolerated window with toxicity above it and patients showed the same shape; the concentration match could not be checked. Superscripts in the quote are lost in the abstract text.
dose.note: Humans were escalated to 1.99 x 10^12 vg/eye; RPE changes capped the dose, and 6.8 x 10^11 vg/eye was tolerated with preliminary efficacy. Dog margin was stated in vg/mL and human doses in vg/eye, so the margin is matched in shape only (tolerated middle, toxic top).
dose.short: Toxic only at top dose, as dogs showed
dose.quote: Preliminary efficacy was observed at the maximum tolerated dose.
dose.reason: Margin held: toxicity only at top dose

efficacy.confidence_note: Abstract-level (Europe PMC, PMID 28549772). Year is publication; XIRIUS phase 1/2 started 2017-03-08.
efficacy.note: AAV8-coRPGR rescued photoreceptor structure and function in Rpgr-/y and Rd9 mice before XIRIUS.
efficacy.quote: Significantly, when delivered by AAV8 vector and driven by the rhodopsin kinase promoter, the codon-optimized RPGR rescues the disease phenotype in two relevant animal models (Rpgr-/y and C57BL/6JRd9/Boc) and shows good safety in C57BL6/J wild-type mice.

efficacy.magnitude_basis: microperimetry responder rate vs untreated control (37.5% and 25.0% vs 22.2%, NS)
efficacy.confidence_note: Press release 2021-05-14; the tier 1 record Lam 2024 (abstract read) and registry results (posted 2024-01-18) confirm the same status. Trial was underpowered after COVID enrolment stop.
efficacy.judgement: Judgement call: mouse rescue implies a functional gain; paired by me, not stated. Underpowering (29 of planned) and a significant low-dose LLVA secondary are noted but do not change a missed primary. LUMEOS (bota-vec, not dosed in these mice) is a class-level second failure recorded in patient_trials.
efficacy.note: XIRIUS phase 2/3 missed its microperimetry responder primary endpoint for cotoretigene; bota-vec's LUMEOS phase 3 also missed its primary in 2025.
efficacy.quote: The XIRIUS study did not meet its primary endpoint of demonstrating a statistically significant improvement in the proportion of treated study eyes with ≥7 dB improvement from baseline at ≥5 of the 16 central loci
efficacy.reason: Mouse rescue did not carry to primary

patient_trials.quote: The primary microperimetry end point was not met.

efficacy.confidence_note: Abstract-level (PMID 31910043). Year is a proxy: HORIZON (NCT03316560) started 2018-04-16, so the dog GLP study predates it; published 2020.
efficacy.note: AGTC-501 rescued photoreceptor function (ERG) and structure (OCT, histology) at low and mid doses in XLPRA2 dogs.
efficacy.quote: Electroretinography, in vivo retinal imaging, and histological analysis showed rescue of photoreceptor function and structure in the absence of ocular toxicity in the low- and mid-dose treatment groups when compared with the vehicle-treated group.

efficacy.magnitude_basis: dog ERG/ONL rescue vs human >=15-letter LLVA responder rate
efficacy.confidence_note: Sponsor press release 2026-09-21 only; NCT04850118 has no posted results and no peer-reviewed paper found. HORIZON (primary endpoint safety) showed microperimetry gains at 6.8 x 10^11 vg/eye.
efficacy.judgement: Judgement call: the dog track is scored on laru-zova only (the product dosed in the dogs); XIRIUS and LUMEOS used other capsids, promoters and doses and are scored on the mouse track. Paired by me.
efficacy.note: Pivotal VISTA met its LLVA responder primary endpoint for laru-zova at both doses (31.0% and 24.1% vs 0% control).
efficacy.quote: VISTA met its FDA-endorsed primary endpoint, demonstrating statistically significant low luminance visual acuity (LLVA) responder rates at Month 12 compared to the untreated control group

efficacy.model: Isogenic RPGR-knockout human iPSC retinal organoids, AAV-RPGR clinical construct (bota-vec)
efficacy.note: Clinical bota-vec construct rescued opsin localisation in human RPGR-KO organoids, framed as supporting phase 1/2 and the ongoing phase 3.
efficacy.short: Organoids support bota-vec ahead of LUMEOS
efficacy.quote: These data provide mechanistic insights into RPGR ORF15 gene supplementation functional potency in human photoreceptor cells and support the previously reported Phase I/II trial positive results using this vector construct in patients with RPGR-associated XLRP
efficacy.confidence_note: Full text (PMC10855600); MeiraGTx-funded. Organoids carried the bota-vec hRKp.RPGR cassette in an AAV7m8 capsid, not the clinical AAV5, so product_in_model is false.
efficacy.judgement: The phase 1/2 trial's primary outcome was safety, so the organoids' agreement with its secondary efficacy signals is not scored as retro; LUMEOS is the first primary-endpoint test.

efficacy.model: Isogenic RPGR-knockout human iPSC retinal organoids, AAV-RPGR clinical construct (bota-vec)

efficacy.confidence_note: Sponsor SEC exhibit (16 Apr 2026); J&J first released the miss on 2 May 2025 (Fierce Biotech, 5 May 2025); the J&J Medical Connect page now returns 404. No peer-reviewed or registry results yet. Organoids carried the bota-vec hRKp.RPGR cassette in an AAV7m8 capsid, not the clinical AAV5, so product_in_model is false.

efficacy.model: Isogenic RPGR-knockout human iPSC retinal organoids, AAV-RPGR clinical construct (bota-vec)
efficacy.note: Retrodiction: the organoids (Feb 2024) showed RPGR rescue after XIRIUS phase 2/3 had already missed its microperimetry primary for cotoretigene (May 2021); efficacy is a claim about the target, so the earlier miss counts and the model failed to reproduce it.
efficacy.short: Rescue shown after XIRIUS had failed
efficacy.quote: The primary microperimetry end point was not met.
efficacy.confidence_note: Abstract-level for Lam 2024 (PMID 38423215); XIRIUS miss first public in the Biogen release of 14 May 2021. Organoids used the bota-vec cassette in AAV7m8, not cotoretigene, so the pairing is target-level only.
efficacy.reason: Organoid rescue contradicts the earlier XIRIUS miss
efficacy.judgement: Judgement call under the retrodiction rule: post-dating alone makes the organoid result a retrodiction for the target; it predicted rescue where patients showed no primary-endpoint benefit, so contra. Paired by me.

safety.confidence_note: Abstract-level (Europe PMC, PMID 28549772). Year is publication; XIRIUS phase 1/2 started 2017-03-08.
safety.note: AAV8-coRPGR showed good safety in wild-type mice; no inflammation reported.
safety.quote: Significantly, when delivered by AAV8 vector and driven by the rhodopsin kinase promoter, the codon-optimized RPGR rescues the disease phenotype in two relevant animal models (Rpgr-/y and C57BL/6JRd9/Boc) and shows good safety in C57BL6/J wild-type mice.

safety.magnitude_basis: ocular inflammation absent in mice, present at higher human doses
safety.confidence_note: Abstract-level for both sides; mouse doses and the full safety readout were not read, so whether the mice reached comparable vector loads is unknown.
safety.judgement: Judgement call: subretinal AAV inflammation is a harm mice can show (and the XLPRA2 dogs did show it at high dose), so the mouse silence is scored a miss; paired by me. XIRIUS phase 2/3 later reported more ocular SAEs at high dose (Lam 2024).
safety.note: First-in-human XIRIUS: steroid-responsive subretinal inflammation at the higher doses, which the mouse safety work had not shown.
safety.quote: Apart from steroid-responsive subretinal inflammation in patients at the higher doses, there were no notable safety concerns after subretinal delivery of an adeno-associated viral vector encoding codon-optimized human RPGR (AAV8-coRPGR), meeting the pre-specified primary endpoint.

safety.confidence_note: Abstract-level (PMID 31910043). Year is a proxy: HORIZON (NCT03316560) started 2018-04-16, so the dog GLP study predates it; published 2020.

safety.judgement: Judgement call: same tissue and dose-dependence, not the same lesion name. Retinal detachments in patients were attributed to surgery and are not scored. Paired by me.
